requests.title: Claims email intake
requests.description: Claims handlers read about 1,200 claim emails per month. For each one they copy the customer name, policy number, date and estimated amount into the claims system, check the policy and decide which queue it goes to. This takes about 6 minutes per email. Emails are free text, some in Finnish.

assessment.summary: Claims handlers process approximately 1,200 claim emails monthly, extracting key information and categorizing them into the claims system.
assessment.rationale: The process involves extracting structured data from unstructured emails and requires decision-making based on policy checks, making it suitable for a hybrid approach.
risks: Misinterpretation of email content due to language differences
Incorrect categorization of claims leading to delays
Data entry errors affecting customer service
Processes personal data: privacy (GDPR) review needed before any pilot.
next_steps: Assess language processing capabilities for Finnish
Determine integration needs with claims system
Pilot with a human reviewing every output before any action is taken.
clarifying_questions: What percentage of emails are in Finnish versus other languages?
Are there specific rules for categorizing claims into queues?
What is the current error rate in manual processing?

requests.title: Monthly management report
requests.description: Every month three analysts copy figures from 5 Excel files into a PowerPoint management report and check the totals. There are 12 such reports per month and each takes about 90 minutes. The Excel layout is always the same.

assessment.summary: Analysts compile monthly management reports by copying figures from Excel files into PowerPoint presentations, ensuring totals are accurate.
assessment.rationale: The process is structured and rule-based, involving repetitive tasks of copying data from Excel to PowerPoint with a consistent layout.
risks: Potential for human error in data copying
Inaccurate totals if not checked properly
next_steps: Implement RPA to automate data extraction and report generation
Test the RPA solution for accuracy and reliability
clarifying_questions: Are there any variations in the Excel files that could affect the automation?
What specific checks are performed on the totals?

requests.title: Customer feedback categorisation
requests.description: We receive about 800 free-text customer feedback messages per month. An assistant reads each one, tags topic and sentiment, and forwards complaints to the right team. It takes roughly 3 minutes per message.

assessment.summary: The process involves categorizing customer feedback messages by tagging their topics and sentiments, and forwarding complaints to the appropriate team.
assessment.rationale: The process involves unstructured text that requires language understanding to extract structured data (topics and sentiments) from customer feedback messages.
risks: Misclassification of feedback leading to unresolved issues
Inaccurate sentiment analysis affecting customer satisfaction
Processes personal data: privacy (GDPR) review needed before any pilot.
next_steps: Evaluate existing tools for text analysis
Consider implementing a GenAI extraction solution
Train the model on historical feedback data
Pilot with a human reviewing every output before any action is taken.
clarifying_questions: What specific topics and sentiments need to be tagged?
Are there any existing guidelines for categorizing feedback?
How are complaints currently prioritized for forwarding?

requests.title: Complex fire-risk exceptions
requests.description: Senior underwriters decide whether to accept unusual fire-risk exceptions for large farms. About 15 cases per month, each takes 2 hours and depends on site visits and judgement. Wrong decisions are very costly.

assessment.summary: Senior underwriters evaluate and decide on unusual fire-risk exceptions for large farms, requiring site visits and expert judgement.
assessment.rationale: The process involves high-judgement decisions based on site visits and expert analysis, making it unsuitable for automation.
risks: High financial impact from incorrect decisions
Dependence on expert judgement may lead to inconsistencies
Processes personal data: privacy (GDPR) review needed before any pilot.
next_steps: Evaluate the need for additional training for underwriters
Consider implementing a decision support tool for underwriters
Review the criteria for fire-risk exceptions
clarifying_questions: What specific criteria are used to evaluate fire-risk exceptions?
How often do underwriters encounter unusual cases?
What data is collected during site visits?
